attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to route between node2's lan-a network and node3's lan-b network, allowing only node2->node3 TCP/5432 and rejecting all other cross-lan traffic. Verified behavior, then performed the mandatory sequential reboot of node1, node2, and node3 with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart re-verification of connectivity and firewall behavior.
